# danbeem.xyz Connecticut Nursing Home Reporting API - full reference

> Read-only, static JSON API of public Connecticut nursing home records (CMS, CT DSS, CT DPH). Schema version reporting-api-1.0. Short version: https://danbeem.xyz/llms.txt. OpenAPI: https://danbeem.xyz/api/openapi.json. Docs: https://danbeem.xyz/api/docs/. Catalog: https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/index.json.

## 1. Conventions

- Host: https://danbeem.xyz (GitHub Pages, static). All URLs end in .json; parameters are in the path. No ?q= or ?type=.
- Facility id: ccn, 6 characters, pattern ^[0-9A-Z]{6}$ (e.g. 075396 Cherry Brook Health Care Center, 075442 60 West). Company id: starts with mc- (e.g. mc-apple-health-care-inc).
- Unknown id: the host returns an HTML 404 page, not JSON.
- Every file has schema_version, generated_at (newest source build date, deterministic), data_as_of (map of source key to date), and links.
- Files are CORS-open and cacheable. No auth, no rate limits.
- Missing data: value is null and the report lists it in missing_data[] as {field, reason}. Absence is not evidence of absence.

## 2. Endpoints and fields

### GET /api/v1/index.json
Catalog. Fields: api, generated_at, data_as_of, docs, openapi, llms, report_schema, facility_report_types[], company_report_types[], url_templates{}, sources{} (agency, dataset, url, as_of, site_file), evidence_kinds{}, counts{facilities, management_companies}.

### GET /api/v1/facilities.json
count, facilities[]: ccn, facility_name, city, operating_status (in_current_cms_provider_info or closed_or_non_current), legal_entity, management_current[], profile (URL).

### GET /api/v1/facilities/{ccn}/profile.json
- identity{ccn, facility_name, address, city, state, zip_code, phone_number, certified_beds_cms, certified_beds_cost_report, ownership_type_cms, legal_entity_cms_enrollment, doing_business_as_cms_enrollment, npi, operating_status, cms_ratings{overall, health_inspection, staffing, quality_measures, as_of}}
- ownership_summary{current_cms_records, management_companies[], current_administrator}
- staffing_latest{quarter, average_resident_census, total_nurse_hprd, rn_hprd, lpn_hprd, aide_hprd, contract_staff_pct, ct_minimum_total_hprd, ct_below_total_minimum_estimate, ct_comparison_status, statewide_median_total_nurse_hprd}
- financial_latest{cost_year, period_start, period_end, revenue_total, expenses_total, net_income, management_fee_reported, related_party_total_reported, direct_care{total, per_resident_day, share_of_expenses}, statewide_median_same_year{...}}
- inspection_summary{all_time_* and recent_* counts of health deficiencies, actual harm, immediate jeopardy, fire safety, fines, payment denials; latest_health_survey_date; survey_enforcement_caution_flags[]; summary_limitations[]}
- missing_data[]; links{ownership, staffing, financials, inspections, reports{...}, site_pages{...}}

### GET /api/v1/facilities/{ccn}/ownership.json
- cms_owners_window{first_release, latest_release}
- cms_ownership_and_control[]: entity_name, entity_type, cms_associate_id, relationship_type, cms_role_verbatim, association_date, first_seen_release, last_seen_release, current, also_listed_at_ccns[], verification, source_key
- management_companies[]: company_id, company_name, relationship_type, start, start_basis, end, ended_before, current, company_url
- administrators_of_record[]: person_id, name, license_number, start, end, current (DPH)
- owners_named_on_dss_cost_reports[]: cost_year, partnership_legal_name, corporation_legal_name, partners_members, directors_officers, stockholders_10pct, record_id
- changes_of_ownership[] (CMS CHOW)

### GET /api/v1/facilities/{ccn}/staffing.json
period_definition, coverage{first_quarter, last_quarter, quarters}, case_mix_expected_hprd_cms, benchmark_note, ct_minimum_note, quarters[]: quarter, average_resident_census, total_nurse_hprd, rn_hprd, lpn_hprd, aide_hprd, contract_staff_pct, ct_direct_care_hprd_estimate, ct_licensed_direct_care_hprd_estimate, ct_minimum_total_hprd, ct_minimum_licensed_hprd, ct_below_total_minimum_estimate, ct_comparison_status, statewide_median_total_nurse_hprd, statewide_median_contract_staff_pct. hprd = hours per resident day.

### GET /api/v1/facilities/{ccn}/financials.json
definitions{}, caveats[], years[]: cost_year, period_start, period_end, part_year, validated_against_printed_totals, name_on_report, resident_days, payer_mix{}, revenue_total, expenses_total, net_income, operating_margin_nursing_home, management_fee_reported, related_party_total_reported, direct_care{salaries, nursing_pool_agency, total, per_resident_day, share_of_expenses}, dietary{}, housekeeping{}, laundry{}, raw_food_per_resident_day, pbj_same_period{}, statewide_median_same_year{}, related_parties[], management_services[]. Check validated_against_printed_totals before relying on a year.

### GET /api/v1/facilities/{ccn}/inspections.json
summary{} (same as profile.inspection_summary); health_citations[]: survey_date, tag, description, category, scope_severity, harm_level, complaint, standard, correction_date, under_idr, record_id; fire_safety_citations[]: survey_date, tag, description, scope_severity, correction_date; penalties[]: date, type, fine_amount, payment_denial_start, payment_denial_days, record_id; scope_severity_key; window{}.

### GET /api/v1/management-companies.json
count, companies[]: id, name, other_names[], homes_total, homes_current, url.

### GET /api/v1/management-companies/{company_id}.json
id, name, other_names[], dph_license{}, homes_total, homes_current, homes[]: ccn, facility_name, role, start, start_basis, end, ended_before, current, context{quarters, first_quarter, last_quarter, ct_direct_care_hprd, total_nurse_hprd, rn_hprd}, administrators[]; source{}; links.

### GET /api/v1/search-index.json
how_to_search, count, entries[]: type (facility, management_company, cost_report_related_party, and others), id, name, ccns[], key. See section 6.

### GET /api/v1/reports/{report_type}/{ccn}.json
Report envelope (schema at /api/v1/schema/report.schema.json). Top-level: schema_version, report_type, subject{ccn, facility_name}, generated_at, data_as_of, executive_summary[]{text, kind, finding_id}, findings[], metrics{}, historical_trends{}, relationships[], sources[]{source_key, agency, dataset, url}, limitations[], missing_data[], recommended_follow_up[], links{}.

Finding: id, kind, severity (info or attention), statement, formula (required when kind is calculated), value (optional), evidence[].
Evidence: source_key, agency, dataset, url, site_file, reporting_period, as_of, record_id, verification, note (optional).
Verification values: source_record, source_record_unvalidated, derived, name_match_unverified.

Report types:
- facility-comprehensive: all sections; metrics include ownership counts, latest_quarter, total_nurse_hprd, rn_hprd, contract_staff_pct, latest_cost_year, direct_care_per_resident_day, management_fee_reported, related_party_total_reported, health_citations_total, immediate_jeopardy_citations, fines_total, most_cited_tags.
- ownership-network: metrics cms_records_all_releases, current_cms_owner_records, current_cms_control_records, shared_principals_with_other_ct_homes.
- staffing-analysis: latest quarter vs CT minimum and state median; trends total_nurse_hprd, contract_staff_pct.
- financial-transparency: latest_cost_year, direct care per resident day vs state median, management fee, related-party total.
- regulatory-history: citation counts, fines, latest survey, most cited tags; trend health_citations_per_year.
- related-party-screening: DSS related-party and management-service disclosures, CMS owners and managers, shared principals, plus an investigative_question for names the user asked about that are absent.

### GET /api/v1/reports/management-company-portfolio/{company_id}.json
Same envelope; subject{company_id, company_name}; metrics homes_total, homes_current, median_ct_direct_care_hprd_during_management.

### GET /api/v1/schema/report.schema.json
JSON Schema 2020-12 for the report envelope.

## 3. Evidence kinds

- confirmed_fact: value printed in a public source record.
- calculated: arithmetic on confirmed facts; `formula` states it.
- possible_association: shared entity, name or principal. Not evidence of ownership, control or conflict of interest.
- investigative_question: something the data cannot answer that a person should check.

## 4. Datasets and as-of dates (from /api/v1/index.json)

- cms_pbj: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Payroll-Based Journal Daily Nurse Staffing; as_of 2026Q2; https://data.cms.gov/quality-of-care/payroll-based-journal-daily-nurse-staffing
- cms_provider_info: CMS, Nursing Home Provider Information (Care Compare); as_of 2026-10-01; https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/dataset/4pq5-n9py
- cms_enrollment: CMS, Skilled Nursing Facility Enrollments; as_of 2026-10-01; https://data.cms.gov/provider-characteristics/hospitals-and-other-facilities/skilled-nursing-facility-enrollments
- cms_all_owners: CMS, Skilled Nursing Facility All Owners (monthly releases); as_of 2026-10; https://data.cms.gov/provider-characteristics/hospitals-and-other-facilities/skilled-nursing-facility-all-owners
- cms_chow: CMS, Skilled Nursing Facility Change of Ownership; as_of SNF_CHOW_2026.09.29.csv; https://data.cms.gov/provider-characteristics/hospitals-and-other-facilities/skilled-nursing-facility-change-of-ownership
- cms_health_citations: CMS, Health Deficiencies (NH_HealthCitations_Oct2026.csv); as_of 2026-11-07; https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/dataset/r5ix-sfxw
- cms_fire_safety: CMS, Fire Safety Deficiencies (NH_FireSafetyCitations_Oct2026.csv); as_of 2026-11-07; https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/dataset/ifjz-ge4w
- cms_penalties: CMS, Penalties (NH_Penalties_Oct2026.csv); as_of 2026-11-07; https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/dataset/g6vv-u9sr
- dss_cost_reports: Connecticut Department of Social Services (DSS), Annual Report of Long-Term Care Facility (nursing facility cost reports); as_of 2026-11-09; https://portal.ct.gov/dss/health-and-home-care/medicaid-nursing-home-reimbursement/nursing-facility-cost-reports
- dph_administrators: Connecticut Department of Public Health (DPH), nursing home administrator of record history (eLicense roster export); as_of 2026-11-05; https://data.ct.gov/Business/State-Licenses-and-Credentials/ngch-56tr
- management_companies: CMS (ownership archives) and Connecticut DPH (management company roster), compiled by danbeem.xyz; as_of 2026-10-28
- site_roster: danbeem.xyz (compiled from CMS and DSS), Connecticut nursing home facility roster; as_of 2026-11-12

## 5. Limitations

- Public CMS, CT DSS and CT DPH data only. No resident data and no Ombudsman case data. Complaints appear only as CMS citation data.
- Data is a snapshot; check data_as_of per source. The roster covers 197 CCNs, including closed or non-current homes.
- CMS PBJ shows hours paid per day, not shifts, time of day, or care given. CT day/night windows cannot be seen. Comparisons to the CT minimum are estimates (ct_comparison_status says how).
- DSS cost-report values were read from published reports; names read from PDFs by software may be truncated. Check validated_against_printed_totals.
- Entities are matched only by CCN, CMS associate id, DPH license number or the site's management company id. Name matches are never merged and carry verification name_match_unverified.
- CMS All Owners may list directors and officers rather than owners for nonprofits.
- Absence from these datasets does not mean absence in the world.
- Citations and staffing flags are screening information, not findings of violations.

## 6. Searching (static hosting)

1. GET https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/search-index.json once.
2. Normalize the query as `key` is: upper case, punctuation to spaces, drop suffixes like INC, LLC.
3. Keep entries whose `key` contains the normalized query. type=facility gives a ccn in `id`; type=management_company gives a company id; other types point to facility ccns via `ccns`.
4. Zero matches: report "not in these datasets" and do not guess.

Comparison of two homes: fetch facility-comprehensive for each CCN and compare metrics{} and findings client-side.

## 7. Worked examples

### Example A: retrieve a facility
1. Search "cherry brook" -> entry {type: facility, id: 075396, name: CHERRY BROOK HEALTH CARE CENTER}.
2. GET https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075396/profile.json. Read identity, staffing_latest (quarter, total_nurse_hprd vs statewide_median_total_nurse_hprd), financial_latest (cost_year, direct_care.per_resident_day), inspection_summary.
3. For narrative with sources, GET https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/reports/facility-comprehensive/075396.json and read executive_summary[] then findings[].
4. Report values with their period, for example "In quarter Q total nurse hours per resident day was X (CMS PBJ, as of 2026Q2)", taking Q from staffing_latest.quarter.

### Example B: inspect ownership
1. GET https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075396/ownership.json.
2. cms_ownership_and_control[] lists each CMS-reported person or entity with cms_role_verbatim and association_date (for example "Adp Of The Snf" since 09/13/2024). current=true means present in the latest release.
3. management_companies[] gives periods: for example ATHENA HEALTH CARE ASSOCIATES, INC. 1994-01-13 to 2025-03-26 (current=false). Say "listed as management company" and give start_basis and source.
4. A non-empty also_listed_at_ccns[] means the same CMS associate id appears at other homes: call it a possible association, not control.
5. An empty CMS owner list for a nonprofit is expected; the report states it as an investigative_question to confirm the licensee with DPH.

### Example C: read a related-party-screening report and attribute a finding
GET https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/reports/related-party-screening/075396.json. Two of its findings:

- confirmed_fact rp-2025-0: "Cost year 2025: related party disclosed as "New Horizons Inc." for Management Services, cost reported $288,000 (Page 16 Line m12)." Evidence: DSS, Annual Report of Long-Term Care Facility, reporting_period 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30, as_of 2026-11-09, record_id "DSS cost report 2025 Page 16 Line m12", verification source_record.
- possible_association rp-mgmt-self-2025: the management-services payee name matches the CMS-enrolled legal entity (NEW HORIZONS INC). The DSS evidence item has verification name_match_unverified.

Correct attribution: "The 2025 DSS cost report lists a $288,000 management-services related-party cost to New Horizons Inc. (DSS cost report 2025, Page 16 Line m12; period 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30; as of 2026-11-09). That name matches the CMS-enrolled legal entity (CMS enrollment, CCN 075396, as of 2026-10-01); this is a possible association based on a name match and does not by itself show what the fee covers."

Wrong: "New Horizons controls the home and takes $288,000" or "no other related parties exist". Names the user asked about that are absent from the data (the report carries an investigative_question) must be reported as "not in these datasets", never as confirmed.

## 8. Prompt template for an assistant

You are summarizing Connecticut nursing home public records from the danbeem.xyz Reporting API.
1. Resolve the facility: fetch https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/search-index.json and match the normalized key, or use a CCN the user gave. Confirm the CCN and name.
2. Fetch https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/reports/{report_type}/{ccn}.json (facility-comprehensive unless the question is narrower). Read data_as_of and limitations too.
3. Answer only from executive_summary, findings, metrics and relationships. Do not add outside knowledge or fill null values.
4. For every statement give: agency and dataset, reporting_period, record_id (and as_of if relevant), taken from the finding's evidence[].
5. Group output by kind: confirmed facts, calculations (with formula), possible associations (say they are not evidence of ownership, control or conflict of interest), questions to follow up.
6. Where data is missing or a name is not found, say "not in these datasets" (name them, with as_of). Never say "none" or "no issues".
7. End with limitations (public CMS/DSS/DPH data only; screening, not findings of violations) and recommended_follow_up.
8. If you cannot fetch URLs, say so and ask the user to paste the JSON.
